about: Editable source of the recorded expedition cues (#242, extended by #243). tools/audio_cues.py build renders every variation from these layers (times in seconds; start/dur cut the source, at places it in the cue, gain in dB, rate scales pitch and speed together) and normalises it to its category's integrated loudness (LUFS), capped at the true-peak ceiling (dBTP).
